meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能利用语言服务器查看代码诊断、跳转到定义、查找引用、搜索符号、检查重命名安全性，并执行重命名。这些操作在当前工作区中进行。
howto.when: 当你在编码后检查错误、探究符号来源、查找所有引用或需要安全地重命名变量/函数时触发。

say.text: 查看这个文件的诊断错误
say.note: 检查文件中由语言服务器报告的代码问题。

say.text: 跳转到这个符号的定义
say.note: 定位光标下符号的原始定义位置。

say.text: 查找这个函数的所有引用
say.note: 搜索工作区中该函数的所有使用点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use language servers to check code diagnostics, go to definitions, find references, search symbols, check rename safety, and perform renames. All operations are scoped to the current workspace.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to inspect code errors after edits, explore symbol definitions, find all references, or safely rename variables/functions.

say_en.note: Check code issues reported by the language server in the current file.

say_en.text: Go to definition of this symbol
say_en.note: Jump to the original definition of the symbol under cursor.

say_en.text: Find all references to this function
say_en.note: Search for all usages of this function across the workspace.
